Ever a good friend to the QW community, {{player|Lurq|flag=se}} has been kind enough to donate some of his precious time in doing the physical work, and his project is nearing its next stage of completion. Because timing was unfortunate, the execution of this tournament necessitated that the commencement of [[Thunderdome_Season_7|Thunderdome season 7]] was postponed by one full week. TD7 would now start on the weekend of the 15th of October, 2016. ==Format== 2 divisions, single elimination tournament.
